$comment: Image slot manifest — single source of truth for static-site placeholders (PLAN_STATIC_HOMEPAGE.md Section F). scripts/gen-placeholders.mjs emits one deterministic SVG per slot into static/images/placeholders/. Each 'whatToShow' text is the future AI prompt body (style lock prefix from 02 §8).
styleLock: children's book illustration, soft warm lighting, magical forest, brave young girl, inclusive, gentle atmosphere, no horror, consistent character design, democratic everyday situations in a magical setting
